The present writ petition has been filed for directing upon the respondents to pay compensation to the petitioners which is due on account of acquisition of their land under the Coal Bearing Act for Tapin Project and further provide employment to the dependents/ successors of original recorded tenants as per the scheme of the central coal fields limited on account of the acquisition of land.
2.
Learned counsel for the petitioners seeks permission to withdraw the present writ petition with a liberty to file fresh one with better particulars.
3. Learned counsel for the respondents is present.
5. Accordingly, the present writ petition stands dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
6. Pending interlocutory application, if any, stands disposed of.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
